risks.proof: close-up photo of a back cover, barcode/ISBN, and a few interior pages showing print quality

risks.risk: Physical condition (page yellowing, highlighting, torn pages, water damage, missing pages) not visible at this resolution
risks.proof: close-up photos of spine, edges, and a few open interior pages per book or a representative sample

risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only the 20 titles clearly visible, no bonus items assumed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of 3-4 back covers showing barcode/ISBN and publisher imprint to confirm originality
Photo of book spines showing printing quality and any binding wear
Photos of a few interior pages per book to check for writing, highlighting, or missing pages
A fresh, undated photo of the actual bundle on hand (not the reused jiji listing image)
response.reason: The books are clearly identifiable by title from the photos, but condition, originality, and whether this is the actual current stock (vs. a reused listing photo) are all unverifiable remotely, so the bundle must be priced at worst-case used/uncertain-edition condition until closer proof is given.
